title: VPN setup on Windows
text: Install the GlobalConnect client from the Software Center. Sign in with your work email and approve the push notification in the Authenticator app. The VPN gateway is vpn.vasterby.example.

title: VPN disconnects frequently
text: If the VPN drops every few minutes, switch from Wi-Fi to a wired connection and disable power saving for the network adapter. Persistent drops should be reported with the client log file attached.

title: VPN på Mac
text: Installera GlobalConnect från Self Service på din Mac. Ge appen behörighet under Systeminställningar > Integritet. Starta om datorn efter installationen.

title: Password reset
text: Reset your password at the self-service portal password.vasterby.example. You need a registered mobile number. Passwords must be at least 14 characters and are valid for 365 days.

title: Glömt lösenord utan mobil
text: Om du inte har registrerat ett mobilnummer måste du besöka servicedesken med giltig legitimation. Servicedesken i stadshuset är öppen vardagar 08–16.

title: Account locked
text: Your account locks after 10 failed sign-in attempts and unlocks automatically after 30 minutes. Call the service desk if you need it unlocked sooner.

title: New phone and MFA
text: When you change phones, register the new device at mysignins before resetting the old one. If the old phone is lost, the service desk can issue a temporary access pass valid for 8 hours.

title: MFA-kod kommer inte
text: Kontrollera att telefonens klocka är synkroniserad automatiskt. Notiser kräver att Authenticator-appen får skicka meddelanden. Använd annars engångskoden i appen.

title: Shared mailbox access
text: Access to a shared mailbox is requested by the mailbox owner through the IT portal form 'Funktionsbrevlåda'. It appears in Outlook within 2 hours after approval.

title: Out of office
text: Set automatic replies in Outlook under File > Automatic Replies. In Outlook on the web it is under Settings > Mail > Automatic replies. Include an alternative contact.

title: Mailbox full
text: Standard mailboxes have a 50 GB quota. Empty Deleted Items and enable online archiving, which gives an additional 100 GB archive.

title: Phishing report
text: Report suspicious emails with the 'Report' button in Outlook. Do not forward phishing emails to colleagues. If you clicked a link, change your password and call the service desk immediately.

title: Skicka krypterad e-post
text: Skriv [SÄKER] i ämnesraden för att kryptera ett mejl till externa mottagare. Mottagaren får en länk och en engångskod för att läsa meddelandet.

title: Add a printer
text: Printers are added via Follow-Me printing: install the 'FollowMe' queue from Software Center, print, then badge in at any printer to release the job within 24 hours.

title: Utskrift fastnar
text: Om utskriften inte släpps vid skrivaren, kontrollera att passerkortet är kopplat till ditt konto i IT-portalen. Jobb raderas automatiskt efter 24 timmar.

title: Color printing
text: Colour printing is disabled by default to reduce cost. Managers can request colour rights for their unit through the IT portal; cost is charged to the unit at 1.20 SEK per page.

title: Order a new laptop
text: Laptops are replaced every four years. Your manager orders a new one in the IT portal under Hardware. Delivery takes about 10 working days.

title: Broken screen
text: Accidental damage is covered once per device lifetime. Report the damage in the IT portal and bring the laptop to the service desk; a loaner is provided while it is repaired.

title: Docking station
text: The standard USB-C dock supports two external monitors. If monitors stay black, update the dock firmware from Software Center and reconnect the cable.

title: Mobiltelefon
text: Anställda med behov får en tjänstetelefon. Chefen beställer i IT-portalen. Telefonen måste vara registrerad i Intune innan e-post kan synkas.

title: Headset
text: USB headsets are ordered through the IT portal accessories catalogue. Bluetooth headsets are not supported for Teams meetings on desktop computers.

title: Install software
text: Approved software is self-installed from Software Center. Software not in the catalogue requires a request with business justification and is reviewed by the security team within 5 working days.

title: Adobe Acrobat licence
text: Acrobat Pro licences are assigned per user and cost the unit 2,400 SEK per year. Acrobat Reader is free and available to everyone in Software Center.

title: Administratörsrättigheter
text: Lokala administratörsrättigheter ges inte till ordinarie användare. Utvecklare kan ansöka om tidsbegränsad behörighet via Privilege Management i högst 4 timmar.

title: Windows updates
text: Windows updates install automatically on Wednesdays. You can postpone a restart up to three times. Computers not updated for 30 days are blocked from the network.

title: Teams meeting room
text: Book meeting rooms with Teams Rooms equipment in Outlook by adding the room as a resource. The room screen shows the meeting and you join with one tap.

title: Teams external guests
text: External guests can join Teams meetings via link without an account. Adding externals as team members requires the team owner to request guest access.

title: Teams-ljud fungerar inte
text: Välj rätt ljudenhet under Inställningar > Enheter i Teams. Gör ett testsamtal. Om det fortfarande inte fungerar, starta om Teams och kontrollera att headsetet inte är tystat.

title: Where to store files
text: Store personal working files in OneDrive and shared unit files in SharePoint team sites. Network drive H: is read-only since 2025 and will be shut down.

title: Restore deleted file
text: Deleted files in OneDrive and SharePoint can be restored from the recycle bin for 93 days. After that, contact the service desk; backups are kept for one year.

title: Share with external party
text: Share files externally with SharePoint links set to 'Specific people'. Links to externals expire after 30 days. Never share documents containing personal identity numbers externally.

title: Stora filer
text: För filer större än 250 GB används tjänsten Filöverföring i IT-portalen. Länken gäller i 7 dagar.

title: Lost laptop
text: Report a lost or stolen laptop to the service desk immediately and file a police report. The device is remotely wiped. Disks are encrypted with BitLocker.

title: USB memory sticks
text: Only encrypted USB sticks issued by IT may be used. Other USB storage is blocked. Encrypted sticks are ordered through the accessories catalogue.

title: Personuppgiftsincident
text: En personuppgiftsincident ska anmälas till dataskyddsombudet inom 24 timmar via formuläret i intranätet. Kommunen anmäler vidare till IMY inom 72 timmar vid behov.

title: Security awareness training
text: All employees must complete the annual security awareness course in the learning platform. It takes about 45 minutes. Managers receive a report of incomplete courses.

title: Screen lock
text: Lock your screen with Windows+L whenever you leave your desk. Computers lock automatically after 10 minutes of inactivity.

title: New employee account
text: The manager creates the account in the HR system at least 5 working days before the start date. The new employee receives credentials by text message on the first day.

title: Employee leaving
text: Accounts are disabled at 17:00 on the last employment day. The mailbox is kept for 90 days and can be forwarded to the manager on request.

title: Konsultkonto
text: Konsulter får ett konto med prefixet ext-. Kontot är giltigt högst 12 månader och förlängs av beställande chef.

title: Name change
text: After a name change, HR updates the HR system and your email address is changed automatically within one day. The old address keeps working as an alias.

title: Guest Wi-Fi
text: Visitors use the network 'Vasterby-Gast'. They register with a mobile number and receive a code valid for 24 hours.

title: Wi-Fi för anställda
text: Anställdas datorer ansluter automatiskt till nätverket 'Vasterby-Personal' med certifikat. Privata enheter ska använda 'Vasterby-Privat' och har bara internetåtkomst.

title: Eduroam
text: School staff can use eduroam at other institutions with their work email and a separate eduroam password set in the IT portal.

title: Working abroad
text: Working from outside the EU requires approval from your manager and the security team, because some systems block foreign IP addresses. Apply at least two weeks before travel.

title: Home office equipment
text: Employees with approved remote work can borrow one monitor and a keyboard. Equipment is returned when remote work ends.

title: Case management system access
text: Access to the case management system Ärendo is requested by your manager. Training must be completed before the account is activated.

title: Ärendo är långsamt
text: Om Ärendo är långsamt, rensa webbläsarens cache och använd Edge. Driftstörningar publiceras på driftinfo-sidan på intranätet.

title: E-signing
text: Documents are signed electronically with the e-signing service using BankID. Signed documents are archived automatically in the document management system.

title: Time reporting
text: Time is reported in the HR self-service portal by the 5th of the following month. Contact payroll, not IT, for questions about salary.

title: Diarium
text: Allmänna handlingar registreras i diariet inom en arbetsdag. Registratorn hjälper till med diarienummer och sekretessmarkering.

title: Service desk hours
text: The service desk is open weekdays 07:30–17:00 by phone internal extension 4500. Critical outages outside office hours go to the on-call technician via the same number.

title: Priority levels
text: Tickets are prioritised P1 to P4. P1 means many users cannot work and has a 1 hour response target. P4 requests have a 5 working day target.

title: Driftinformation
text: Planerade underhållsfönster sker söndagar 06–10. Information skickas ut minst tre dagar i förväg.

title: Ticket status
text: You can follow your tickets in the IT portal under My cases. You receive an email when the status changes or when the technician needs more information.

title: Accessibility tools
text: Screen readers and magnification software are available on request. The accessibility coordinator helps set up adapted workplaces.

title: AI assistant policy
text: Generative AI tools may only be used with public information. The approved assistant is available in Edge when signed in with your work account; do not paste personal data into it.

title: Browser
text: Microsoft Edge is the standard browser. Chrome is available in Software Center but some internal systems are only tested with Edge.

title: Return equipment
text: Return old laptops and phones to the service desk. Data is erased according to NIST guidelines and the equipment is recycled.

title: Scanning
text: Scan to email by badging in at a printer and choosing Scan to me. The PDF is sent to your work email address within a few minutes.

title: Distribution lists
text: Distribution lists are created on request by a manager. Owners can manage members themselves in Outlook.

title: Teams webinar
text: Large events with more than 300 participants should use Teams town hall. Contact communications for help with production.

title: Password manager
text: The approved password manager is available in Software Center. Do not store work passwords in the browser on shared computers.

title: Versionshistorik
text: SharePoint sparar upp till 500 versioner av ett dokument. Högerklicka på filen och välj Versionshistorik för att återställa en äldre version.
